            )
        )

    num_layers = 3  # Adjust for better performance
    max_iter = 50  # Adjust for better performance

    # Create the QAOA solver
    solver = Solver(max_iter=max_iter)

    # Define the objective function (negative of the cut value)
    def objective(params):

        return 0

    # Solve the Max-Cut problem using QAOA
    result = solver.read(constraints, objective=objective)
    
    # Extract the results
    approximation_ratio = result["approximation_ratio"]
    success_probability = result["success_probability"]
    circuit_depth = result["circuit_depth"]
    two_qubit_gate_count = result["two_qubit_gate_count"]
    shots = result["shots"]
